title: Engraved betel box
summary: Turn a tall box with a domed lid, coat it in layers of coloured lac, then scrape lines, scrolls and leaves through the layers to show the colours beneath.
howToPlay: The box in its frame shows what to make.
Drag across the wood to set its width, then tap the bands to lay the lac.
Pick a graver and scrape each lit mark: a deeper cut shows a lower layer.
rules: Shape counts for half the score, the lac on each band for a quarter, and the engraved marks for a quarter.
A line and a scroll show the layer beneath; a leaf cuts deeper and shows the layer under that.
Three stars for 88 or more, two stars for 65 and one star for 40. Watch and learn makes a whole piece for you.
heritageNote: Burmese lacquerware is built from many thin coats of lac on a bamboo or wood core. Makers scratch designs through the coats, and the colours that show depend on how deep each cut goes.
